components.name: Button
components.summary: The primary action. One primary per view; secondary and ghost for the rest.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the ellipsis and disables the button.

props.name: type
props.description: Defaults to button so a form action stays explicit.

a11y: A focus ring (2px brand) is visible on every variant.
A loading button is disabled, not hidden.

components.name: Input
components.summary: A single-line field. The error border comes from aria-invalid, so a form sets it once.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Switches the border and the ring to the danger token.

a11y: Every input has a label (the Field primitive pairs them).
aria-invalid is set with the error text, never instead of it.

components.name: Field
components.summary: A labelled field with an optional error and help line. The error is absolute, so it never shifts the layout.
a11y: The error is announced with the control (aria-describedby).
The label is always visible.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: An inline message about the current state: info, success, warning or danger.
a11y: The danger variant uses role=alert at the call site.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: What to do when a list is empty: a title, a reason and one action.
a11y: The action is a real button, not a link-shaped div.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switches between sibling views. The underline variant is for pages, the pills for panels.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; label: string; count?: number }[]

a11y: The tablist has an aria-label.
The selected tab is aria-selected.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: The loading placeholder; SkeletonText is the multi-line form.
a11y: The region marks aria-busy while the skeleton shows.

components.name: HelpTip
components.summary: The glossary term with a hover/focus popover.
a11y: The trigger is a button with the term as its name.
Escape closes the popover.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: The small centred dialog; a destructive confirm uses ConfirmDialog instead.
a11y: role=dialog + aria-modal.
Escape closes it.

components.name: SidePanel
components.summary: The drawer a form opens in. It always has a footer (Close when there is no action) and asks before losing unsaved changes.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Closes it; the dirty guard asks first.

a11y: role=dialog + aria-modal + aria-labelledby.
Escape closes it (after the dirty guard).

components.name: ConfirmDialog
a11y: role=alertdialog.
The destructive action is never the default focus.

components.name: PromptDialog
a11y: The input has a label.
aria-invalid appears with the error.
